jobs.title: Product Owner 2
jobs.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Purpose Summary

As a Product Owner, I am responsible for understanding customer needs and business objectives for my product(s) and for delivering a successful product through the effective leadership of the development team, ensuring delivery aligns with the Product Manager's roadmap. I produce software with excellent user experience and high customer satisfaction.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities
- I lead cross-functional product delivery, working closely with development, engineering and other internal teams to deliver high-quality products, features and releases that align with the product vision, roadmap, business objectives and identified market needs.

- I identify problems encountered by the customer, bringing cross-functional teams together and establishing working groups to deliver high quality products that meet customer needs and drive business growth.

- I collaborate with the Product Manager, UX team and other stakeholders.

- I manage scope to timescales and budget.

- I represent our users in all our digital product decisions.

- I collect, manage and prioritise product features and requirements from all stakeholders across the business and externally, according to business value.

- I define user journeys and translate identified needs into clear, prioritised product requirements.

- I maintain a concise, prioritised and clear backlog of User Stories and Bugs, balancing the needs of the business alongside technical debt, security and other priorities.

- I facilitate product demonstrations and other feedback activities to validate delivered functionality and inform future priorities, including organising ongoing sprint demo sessions to solicit and collect feedback from stakeholders.

- I produce testable User Stories meeting the definition of ready for the development team that deliver value within a single sprint and align with the solution objectives.

- I ensure well documented, testable non-functional requirements.

- I ensure requirements consider system configuration options and define appropriate defaults.

- I ensure requirements consider application security and align to the development process and regulatory/compliance guidelines.

- I can use Generative AI to help create User and Functional requirements, and I know when to leverage AI and when not to do so.

- The employee agrees to take over additional reasonable tasks that align with their abilities, if required.

Experience and Educational Requirements
- Bachelor's degree, ideally in a related field, or equivalent and demonstrable experience as a Product Owner/Manager.

- Minimum 1 years' experience as a Business Analyst, Product Owner or Product Manager.

- Experience using AI tools and Generative AI

- Experience working with pharmaceutical software, eTMFs, Pharmacovigilance and/or Regulatory Affairs tooling is preferred but not essential.

- English language fluency.

Minimum Skills, Knowledge and Ability Requirements
- I have experience performing requirements analysis and writing specification documents to deliver customer outcomes.

- I have experience delivering products using agile development methodology techniques, working directly with developers/technical teams.

- I have a data-driven focus and experience interpreting data and translating it into stories, using it to drive product strategy.

- I have a deep understanding of product-specific market personas and their challenges.

- I am strong across execution, highly analytical and data-driven, drive decisions, and create experiences that customers love.

- I have experience defining user journeys and stories and setting good quality story standards.

Technical skills:
- Requirements analysis (ideally including SaaS & Managed Service Products).

- Agile SCRUM.

- Use of JIRA.

- Ability to write BDD and understanding of Cucumber/Gherkin.

- Ability to derive and document non-functional requirements.

- Able to convey technical and non-technical ideas and concepts to varied audiences.

- Backlog management and refinement.

- Understanding of SDLC processes.

- Understanding of UX and product design.

- Self-motivated with a relentless drive and passion to make improvements and achieve results.

.
Bachelor's degree in business administration, marketing, economics, engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience required.

Less than 2 years of experience in product management, product operations, business analysis, market research, project coordination, or a related field required.

Certification in product management, agile practices, or business analysis preferred.

The Product Owner – Customer Portal is responsible for evolving World Courier’s suite of customer-facing portal experiences into modern, scalable, intuitive, and increasingly AI-enabled digital platforms that support global operations, enhance customer engagement.

Why this role matters
Customer portals are central to how customers interact with World Courier—placing orders, tracking shipments, and accessing critical logistics information. This role ensures that our customer portals evolve into integrated, consistent, and user-centric digital experiences, reducing reliance on manual interactions and enabling scalable, self-service capabilities across regions and markets.

A key measure of success will be the ability to drive customer adoption of digital channels, increasing usage of portal-based interactions and reducing dependency on manual, email- and phone-based processes.

What you’ll do

Product Ownership & Delivery
- Co-own and manage the product backlog for customer portal platforms, ensuring clear prioritization aligned to business and customer outcomes.
- Drive delivery in an agile environment, working closely with engineering, design, and QA teams in your squad
- Translate business needs into well-defined user stories and acceptance criteria.

Product Scope & Evolution
- Own product delivery across: - Global Customer Portal platform
- China-specific Customer Portal
- Shipment event–driven tracking and communications
- Future mobile application opportunities

- Continuously enhance portal capabilities to support: - Order placement, including packaging selection
- Customer visibility and tracking transparency
- Event-driven notifications and communications
- Document exchange
- Pricing and invoicing
- Chat-based customer support and assistance
- Agentic AI features that help customers complete portal tasks and navigate next-best actions

Alignment & Collaboration
- Co-own the product vision and roadmap, working closely with the Product Group Manager and working in a “two-in-a-box” model with the business Product Manager.
- Collaborate closely with the Customer Integrations Product Owner to ensure seamless end-to-end customer experiences across the products.
- Align with peer Product Owners and Product Group Managers to support cross-product initiatives and dependencies.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation
- Stay abreast of emerging technologies, digital experience trends, and competitor capabilities in customer portals and logistics platforms.
- Help lead the team into AI-enabled product development by identifying practical use cases, shaping AI-informed product features, and embedding responsible, value-driven AI thinking into product delivery. - Small enhancements and usability improvements
- Platform upgrades and modernization
- Security and compliance improvements

What we’re looking for
You’ll thrive in our team if you:
- Have a passion for creating intuitive, customer-facing digital experiences that make complex processes feel simple
- Bring creativity, fresh thinking, and a willingness to challenge convention in pursuit of better solutions
- Are energized by the opportunity to exceed customer expectations through thoughtful, innovative product experiences

Experience that will help you succeed:
- Strong experience as a Product Owner in agile environments.
- Strong understanding of digital platforms, portals, or customer-facing applications.
- Ability to balance strategic priorities with continuous delivery and operational needs.
- Strong stakeholder engagement skills across business and technology teams.
- Experience working in globally distributed and matrixed organizations
- Experience in a regulated environment such as healthcare logistics, is highly desirable
- Demonstrated ability to lead teams into AI-enabled product development, translating emerging AI capabilities into practical product opportunities and delivery approaches.

What success looks like in this role
- Customer-facing portals that increasingly differentiate World Courier from competitors through intuitive, high-value, globally consistent digital experiences

- Strong alignment with integrations and backend systems, enabling seamless customer journeys.
- Continuous delivery of incremental value through enhancements, upgrades, and innovation.
- Visible progress toward AI-enabled product capabilities that improve customer experience, team effectiveness, and operational efficiency.
- Increased customer adoption of digital channels, with measurable shifts from manual to self-service interactions.
- High stakeholder engagement and improved customer satisfaction.

You’ll have the opportunity to:
- Play a key role in a re-imagined IT function
- Work with smart, committed people who care about doing the right thing
- Shape a modern, people-centred, visible, high-impact, customer-facing function
- Work within a collaborative, product-led organization driving digital transformation.

- Make a real difference to how people experience technology every day

jobs.description:

Job Details

Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At World Courier (a Cencora company), we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

We exist to help the organisation rise, adapt, and grow, using technology that is innovative, integrated, reliable, secure, and designed around real operational needs.

The Product Owner – Depot Solutions is responsible for owning and evolving a portfolio of business-critical legacy and enabling technologies that support World Courier’s global depot, warehouse, document management, vendor management, and finance-related workflows. This includes the platform used by depots for operational processes, as well as enabling platforms such as Filebound and key liaison responsibilities with Finance applications including Tradeshift, SAP S/4HANA, and EWM.

Why this role matters
Legacy and enabling technologies are foundational to how World Courier operates day-to-day across global depot and warehouse environments, supports critical depot workflows such as inbound processing, outbound movement, quarantine handling, returns, kitting, and related operational activities. Enabling technologies such as document management and finance-adjacent applications ensure operational processes remain connected, compliant, auditable, and aligned with enterprise systems.

A key measure of success will be the ability to stabilize, simplify, and modernize this mixed portfolio of custom and commercial off-the-shelf platforms while ensuring strong vendor performance, effective stakeholder engagement, and practical alignment with broader transformation efforts such as SAP S/4HANA and EWM-enabled process evolution.

What you’ll do

Product Ownership & Delivery
- Co-own and manage the product backlog for legacy and enabling technology platforms, ensuring clear prioritization aligned to depot operations, compliance, finance, vendor performance, and enterprise transformation priorities.
- Drive delivery in an agile environment, working closely with engineering, delivery, support, vendor, and business teams to deliver reliable enhancements, fixes, upgrades, and process improvements.
- Translate operational, finance, compliance, and vendor management needs into well-defined user stories, acceptance criteria, prioritization decisions, and measurable outcomes.

Product Scope & Evolution
- Own product delivery across: - CTM-STAR legacy depot and warehouse technology supporting inbound, outbound, quarantine, returns, kitting, and related operational workflows, as well as its successor product(s)
- Enabling technologies that support operational execution, documentation, workflow management, vendor oversight, and compliance
- Finance application touchpoints and liaison responsibilities with platforms such as Tradeshift and SAP S/4HANA

- Continuously evolve the portfolio to support: - Operational reliability and efficiency across global depot processes
- Modernization of custom and COTS platforms without disrupting critical business operations
- Clear integration and process alignment with enterprise systems and finance applications
- Improved vendor accountability, service quality, and roadmap transparency
- Compliance, auditability, security, and data quality improvements across the portfolio

Alignment & Collaboration
- Co-own the product vision and roadmap, operating in a “two-in-a-box” model with business stakeholders across operations, depots, finance, compliance, and support functions.
- Serve as a liaison between World Courier technology teams, depot operations, Finance application teams, enterprise SAP stakeholders, and external vendors to ensure priorities, dependencies, and delivery plans are understood and coordinated.
- Align with peer Product Owners and Product Group Managers to manage cross-product dependencies, integration impacts, support handoffs, and modernization sequencing.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation
- Stay abreast of emerging technologies, warehouse and depot operations trends, SAP S/4HANA and EWM capabilities, document management practices, vendor management models, and modernization patterns for mixed custom and COTS portfolios.
- Identify practical opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual effort, improve data quality, strengthen controls, and increase operational resilience across legacy and enabling platforms. - Small enhancements and usability improvements
- Platform upgrades, technical debt reduction, and modernization planning
- Security, compliance, audit, integration, and vendor performance improvements

What we’re looking for
You’ll thrive in our team if you:
- Have a strong appreciation for operational technology that underpins critical depot, warehouse, finance, and compliance processes
- Are comfortable working across legacy platforms, custom solutions, and commercial off-the-shelf software while balancing stability, modernization, and business value
- Bring disciplined vendor management, stakeholder engagement, and cross-functional coordination skills to complex enterprise technology environments

Experience that will help you succeed:
- Strong experience as a Product Owner in agile environments, ideally supporting operational, platform, enterprise application, or back-office technology portfolios.
- Strong understanding of depot, warehouse, supply chain, logistics, finance, document management, or enterprise operations technology.
- Good working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA EWM, and related enterprise integration or process impacts.
- Experience managing or partnering with vendors for COTS platforms, including roadmap discussions, service performance, issue escalation, release planning, and commercial awareness.
- Ability to balance strategic modernization priorities with continuous delivery, operational stability, regulatory expectations, and support needs.
- Strong stakeholder engagement skills across depot operations, finance, compliance, technology, support, and external vendor teams.
- Experience working in globally distributed and matrixed organizations.
- Experience in a regulated environment such as healthcare logistics is highly desirable.

What success looks like in this role
- Critical operational workflows are improved via technology
- A clear, business-aligned roadmap for legacy and enabling technologies that balances stabilization, modernization, vendor delivery, and operational value.
- Strong alignment with Finance applications, SAP S/4HANA, document management, and enterprise systems to support integrated ways of working.
- Improved vendor accountability, release discipline, service quality, issue resolution, and roadmap transparency across COTS platforms.
- Continuous delivery of incremental value through enhancements, upgrades, simplification, technical debt reduction, and compliance improvements.
- High stakeholder confidence across depot operations, finance, technology, compliance, support, and vendor teams.

.
Requirements

Bachelor's degree in business administration, marketing, communications, product management, economics, healthcare administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience required.
Master's degree in business administration, marketing, communications, product management, economics, healthcare administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience preferred.

10+ years of experience in product management, product strategy, commercialization, innovation, marketing, or a related field required.
5+ years of experience in a management capacity required.

Certification in project management, customer success management, service management, agile delivery, or product implementation preferred.

Why join World Courier GDATS?
You’ll have the opportunity to:
- Play a key role in a re-imagined IT function
- Work with smart, committed people who care about doing the right thing

- Shape modern, resilient, operationally critical technology capabilities that support global depot, warehouse, finance, and compliance processes
- Work within a collaborative, product-led organization driving digital transformation.

- Make a real difference to how people experience technology every day

- Work in a purpose-driven business that makes a difference to people’s lives, delivering essential pharma logistics services

How you’ll be working
- This role operates within a global, matrixed IT organisation, working closely with Design, Engineering, Delivery, and business stakeholders.
- Collaboration across time zones and regions is required
- Flexible and hybrid working arrangements apply in line with World Courier policies

Job Details

This role is in support of Securos Surgical, a Cencora business offering veterinary orthopedic and surgical products and services globally.

The private label Product Manager position will own and manage assigned service offerings and product lines with the objective of increasing market share, growing sales revenue, improving margins, etc.  This position will lead and perform complex competitive market analyses to provide guidance on product direction(s) and pricing strategies.  This position will also perform product management actions including; sourcing & identifying approved product vendors/manufacturers, establishing pricing, ensuring high quality standards, risk management/mitigation, inventory tracking & forecasting, etc.

Primary Responsibilities :

The essential functions include, but are not limited to:
- Take ownership and manager assigned product line(s) and service offering(s) including but not exclusively; Securos Surgical/VetOne branded instruments and Vetrilogix medical & diagnostic equipment.
- This role is responsible for building the new private label Vetrilogix brand, expanding the product and service portfolio, and launching into the marketplace.
- Creates and maintains product database to include competitive equivalents, warranties, and pricing data.
- Performs complex competitive product & market analyses to assess current & future market position. Provides guidance and recommendations on future product tactics and strategies.
- Generates reporting metrics to track and forecast product line costs and associated pricing requirements needed to meet business objectives.
- Prepares and presents monthly product line updates and forecasts to internal stakeholders.
- Creates and conducts on-going internal and external product training.
- Serves as point of escalation for highly technical questions from customers (internal and external) regarding complex products and services.
- Builds and maintains vendor/manufacturer relationships to include contract/pricing/supply chain negotiation, product changes/enhancements, product issue resolution, product development, and new product pipeline/market opportunities.
- Serves as a liaison and knowledge resource between MWI sales teams and applicable product/service line.
- Collaborates with Securos marketing team to develop and/or enhance marketing materials for assigned product/service line(s).
- Creates and drives a product line marketing plan that aligns with business strategies.
- Attracts and attains new customers via tradeshows, events, outbound calls, site visits, product training, promotions, etc.
- Attends tradeshows as a representative of Securos Surgical and/or VetriLogix to promote and educate audiences of product/service lines and other business objectives.
- Conducts customer satisfaction surveys.
- Ability to travel (e.g. trade shows, regional sales meetings, internal meetings, vendor site visits, and ride along with reps).
